title: Beverly hovering metallic object
summary: Merrick tells of Beverly hovering metallic object, about 1966 at Beverly, Massachusetts, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Beverly, Massachusetts, 1966. Uh, nine witnesses, two law enforcement officers see a metallic platelike object

plain: A guest named Merrick, debating on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, points to a case from Beverly, Massachusetts, in 1966. He says nine witnesses, two of them police officers, saw a metallic object shaped like a plate hovering there. He offers it as a case with many credible witnesses that is hard to explain away.
